name: the fixture env inherits the whole environment, GIT_DIR included (backlog #373)
edits: env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in ENV_ALLOW if k in os.environ}
expect: the fixture env inherits no GIT_* and nothing off the allow-list

name: the fixture env reads the user's global git config
expect: the fixture env disables global and system git config

name: a world passes on its exit code alone
edits:
return got == want
    return got[0] == want[0]
expect: an exit-code-only comparison is NOT a pass when a different file ran

name: a mutant anchor that occurs twice is applied anyway
expect: a mutant whose anchor occurs twice is UNBOUND, not applied

name: every bound mutant is reported killed, whatever its worlds did
edits: missing = [k for k in m.killers if k not in red]
expect: a mutant that changes nothing is reported SURVIVED, not killed

name: the launcher is run without the logical PWD a shell would export
expect: mutant m6 the logical pwd, not pwd -P is killed

name: the launcher is run with empty stdin
expect: stdin reaches the hook, byte for byte

name: main() reports a pass over a red world
expect: main() over the m1 mutant exits 1 and NAMES a red world

name: an UNSET project dir is run as main's
edits: project = str(w.main) if c.project == "main" else c.project
expect: W14 CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR unset, below main's root: 127 and nothing runs (no worse than today)

name: W10's precondition is not checked: any base counts as outside every checkout (r1 Codex P2)
expect: ⭐ with TMPDIR INSIDE a checkout, main() still measures W10 and exits 0 (r1 Codex P2)

name: the suite stops reading the hook's stdout (r1 Claude M1)
expect: exit 0 with stdout (the shape of the push gate's DENY): stdout, stderr and code arrive exactly

edits: out.append((c.name, (c.want_rc, c.want_ran), (c.want_rc, c.want_ran)) or (c.name, (f"NOT RUN — no base
